description: Curated list of large, liquid NSE stocks used as search suggestions and test symbols.
source: Curated manually by the NeuralVest project. Company names, sectors and industries are fetched from Yahoo Finance (via yfinance) when the list is seeded into MongoDB.
limitations: This is NOT an official index constituent list (e.g. it is not the current NIFTY 50). Any NSE/BSE symbol can still be analysed.
news_aliases_note: Abbreviations Indian newsrooms commonly use in headlines. All-caps aliases are matched case-sensitively as whole words.
